basics.name: Benjamin Roget
basics.label: Software Engineering Student | Backend & Systems
basics.summary: Seeking a 3-month software engineering internship starting June 2027 in Poland, Romania, Czechia or the Nordics, in English-speaking teams; the US is a secondary option. Engineering student and software engineering apprentice with experience building Java/Spring Boot applications and automated testing tools. Personal projects focus on Rust, networking and Linux infrastructure.

work.name: Numih France
highlights: Developed the asynchronous Spring Boot test API within an existing team backend and built the Angular interface end to end to launch, schedule and monitor tests, integrating WebSocket status notifications.
Refactored an existing Selenium/Java framework into reusable abstractions, separating framework code from test scenarios; enabled the same tests to run through Maven/Jenkins or the API.
Improved reliability across roughly 50 to 70 automated tests through test-data lifecycle management (creation, update and deletion) in shared environments.
Cut the time needed to adapt tests after an environment change or a major application version from about four hours to under ten minutes.
Develop and maintain business application features in Java and Angular, and designed a Spring Boot internal tool that now distributes daily product-support duties across about 40 developers.

Led technical assessments for intern and apprentice recruitment, designing Java coding exercises and questionnaires on Java, Hibernate and Agile practices and conducting technical interviews; trained an intern and an apprentice on the testing framework.

work.name: Ekeep-IT
highlights: Developed REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot for My-UUU, an equestrian-facility directory and review platform.
Built responsive Next.js interfaces and delivered features in an Agile/Scrum team.

education.studyType: DUT Informatique (University Diploma of Technology in Computer Science)
education.score: Ranked first in the cohort in each year.

projects.name: min-btc-node
